Local and current online district files have identical SHA-256. Do not merge the modified calendar into this regular district record. Preserve the three opening dates and August 14 regular release. Red text in the district PDF marks academic reporting facts, not student holidays. January 4 is a student/teacher holiday; March 19 is the workday adjoining spring break. District News and Live Feed were checked for calendar changes; no later district-calendar revision was verified in the reviewed material. editorialSummary.heading: Three opening dates and a Friday schedule to check
paragraphs: Brevard families have different opening dates to plan around. Most students begin August 10, kindergarten begins August 13, and prekindergarten begins August 17. The first Friday, August 14, has regular release. Early release starts August 21 and continues on the listed school Fridays, with additional shortened exam days in December and May. Your school’s bell schedule supplies pickup times.

The winter return is January 5, after a January 4 holiday for students and teachers. The first semester then ends January 8, another early-release day. In March, the student holiday and teacher workday on March 19 leads into the March 22-26 Spring Break. Classes are scheduled to resume March 29, when secondary report cards also appear on FOCUS.

FOCUS dates differ by school level. Elementary final report cards are issued May 26 and posted May 27; secondary final cards are listed for June without an exact day. Challenger 7 families should use their school’s modified calendar instead of this regular district schedule. The district publishes that calendar separately in the same download folder.

about.dataSource: The supplied two-page district PDF matches the current download linked from Brevard’s Printable District Calendars folder. It prints Board Approved 2/24/26 and 180 pupil days. The companion grid, separate Make Up Day Priority sheet and district notice about Challenger 7 were also reviewed.
about.processing: All 33 explicitly listed Friday early releases are retained, plus the six December and May exam/early-release dates. The May 24-26 source range is split into May 24-25 and the existing May 26 final-day event so the last day, early release, exam, semester end and elementary report-card issuance export together. Reporting facts sharing an early-release or holiday date do not narrow the attendance scope of that whole event; their school-level limits remain in the names and notes. Winter is three distinct official entries joined only in the planning summary. The March 19 workday precedes, rather than follows, the named spring break. There are 208 weekdays in the regular-year span and 28 no-class weekdays, matching the printed 180 pupil days and 90/90 semester split. The month-only June secondary report-card entry is explained in the FAQ without a fabricated June day or month-long event. Administrative FTE surveys, teacher preplanning and postplanning, and Memorial Day after the student year are omitted.
about.updates: The official district PDF, current document folder, calendar-grid PDF, make-up sheet, district News and Live Feed were checked October 15, 2026. The July 21 district notice identifies Challenger 7 as the only modified-calendar school and confirms its July 20 opening. The make-up plan describes a priority process, not activation of a named holiday or an already revised semester-end date.
about.disclaimer: Use the modified calendar for Challenger 7. Your school supplies exam assignments, dismissal times and the exact June secondary report-card release. Later district notices may change schedules after an emergency closure.

faqs.question: When does the 2026-2027 school year start in Brevard County?
faqs.answer: The regular district school year starts Monday, August 10, 2026. Kindergarten begins Thursday, August 13, and prekindergarten begins Monday, August 17. Challenger 7 has its own modified calendar, so families there should use the school’s separate dates.

faqs.question: Does Challenger 7 follow this district calendar?
faqs.answer: No. BPS identifies Challenger 7 Elementary as its modified-calendar school, and its 2026-2027 year began July 20, 2026. Use the separate Modified Challenger 7 Calendar in the district’s printable-calendar folder for that school’s attendance and break dates.

faqs.question: What is the last day of school, and do students leave early?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, May 26, 2027, is the last student day, the end of the second semester and an exam/early-release day. Elementary report cards are issued that day. School-specific exam and dismissal notices provide the times.

faqs.question: Are all Fridays early release days?
faqs.answer: The first early release is August 21, 2026. August 14 is explicitly a regular release day. Later school Fridays generally have early release, but holidays and workdays such as September 25 and March 19 have no student classes. The December and May exam schedules also include early release on days other than Friday.

faqs.question: How early are students dismissed, and where do I find pickup times?
faqs.answer: The district calendar identifies early-release dates but gives no clock times or number of minutes shortened. Check your school’s current bell schedule and notices. Exam-day dismissal instructions may differ from a routine Friday schedule.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Brevard County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break is Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27. Students are scheduled to return Monday, November 30. Elementary interim reports are also scheduled to appear on FOCUS on that return date.

faqs.question: Does winter break include January 4, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. The December 21-31 winter holiday, January 1 holiday and January 4 student/teacher holiday give students a continuous break. Students and teachers return Tuesday, January 5. January 4 is a holiday for both groups, not a teacher workday.

faqs.question: Does the March 19 workday extend spring break?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes Friday, March 19, 2027, for a teacher workday. The named Spring Break is March 22-26. With the weekend between them, students are off continuously March 19-28 and are scheduled to return Monday, March 29. March 29 is also the secondary report-card publication date.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays are student holidays?
faqs.answer: Students are off September 25 and October 12, 2026, and February 15 and March 19, 2027. February 15 is Presidents Day and is specifically listed as a student holiday and teacher workday. January 4 belongs to winter break for students and teachers.

faqs.question: Are schools closed for Labor Day, Veterans Day and Martin Luther King Jr. Day?
faqs.answer: Those student holidays are September 7 and November 11, 2026, and January 18, 2027. The calendar calls each a holiday for all. Thanksgiving, winter break and spring break are listed separately.

faqs.question: When are the December and May exam days?
faqs.answer: Exam Days/Early Release is listed for December 16-18, 2026, and May 24-26, 2027. Every weekday in each range is included. Your school assigns exam periods and tells families when students need to report; the district PDF does not supply those details.

faqs.question: Does the first semester end before winter break?
faqs.answer: No. The first semester ends Friday, January 8, 2027, which is also an early-release day. Students return from winter break January 5 and finish that semester during the same week. The second semester ends May 26.

faqs.question: What are the first- and third-quarter closing dates?
faqs.answer: The first nine weeks ends October 13, 2026, and the third nine weeks ends March 16, 2027. Neither date is labeled a student holiday. Report cards are published later, on different dates for elementary and secondary students.

faqs.question: When are elementary interim reports posted on FOCUS?
faqs.answer: Elementary interims are scheduled for September 16 and November 30, 2026, and February 17 and April 30, 2027. April 30 also has early release. These dates are for progress updates rather than quarterly report cards.

faqs.question: When do secondary interims and block report cards appear on FOCUS?
faqs.answer: The publication dates are September 14 and November 19, 2026, and February 15 and April 28, 2027. February 15 is a student holiday; online report availability does not make it a school attendance day. The block report-card part applies to the relevant block-scheduled courses.

faqs.question: When are elementary report cards issued and posted online?
faqs.answer: The first three FOCUS publication dates are October 20, 2026, January 15, 2027, and March 31, 2027. Final elementary report cards are issued May 26 and published on FOCUS May 27. January 15 also has early release.

faqs.question: What are the secondary report-card dates, including the final one?
faqs.answer: Secondary report cards are published on FOCUS October 16, 2026, January 13, 2027, and March 29, 2027. The final publication is listed only as June, with no specific day. Check FOCUS and school notices for the final release date.

faqs.question: When do the four interim periods close?
faqs.answer: The interim closing dates are September 9 and November 16, 2026, and February 10 and April 23, 2027. These are the period cutoffs; the corresponding FOCUS reports come later. April 23 is also an early-release day.

faqs.question: How does Brevard plan to make up weather closures?
faqs.answer: The separate Make Up Day Priority sheet uses first-semester built-in instructional time for one, two or three missed days. At four and five days, it calls for pushing the first semester into the second. At six days, it calls for discussions with the Brevard Federation of Teachers about using early-release time. It does not assign specific holiday make-up dates; follow district announcements for any actual change.

faqs.question: How many pupil days are in the published district calendar?
faqs.answer: The PDF lists 180 pupil days, with 90 in each semester. That is the regular district calendar total. Kindergarten and prekindergarten have later starting dates, and Challenger 7 uses a different calendar, so the figure should not be read as an identical attendance schedule for every program.

faqs.question: Where can families find 2027 graduation dates?
faqs.answer: The annual district calendar does not list graduation ceremonies. May 26 is the final student day, not an announced districtwide graduation date. Use your high school’s Class of 2027 graduation information for the ceremony, rehearsal and ticket details.

faqs.question: Where is the official approved calendar and any later update?
faqs.answer: The district’s Printable District Calendars folder links the 2026-2027 District Calendar, its calendar-grid view and a separate make-up priority sheet. The district calendar is marked Board Approved February 24, 2026. Check that folder and district or school announcements for later schedule changes.
